title: Asking the Way
label: ch:ml-asking-the-way
canDo: I can ask where a place is and how to get there, and follow and give simple directions: straight on, left, right, at the junction.

payoff.summary: Complete ML-R343-asking-the-way: ask for the station, follow and give a route with nēre, iṭattōṭṭŭ and valattōṭṭŭ, and read the new letter ഡ in റോഡ്.
